instruction: Search for kids' Disney princess toys and list them in ascending order of price.

metadata.explanation: Task variation searches for Disney princess toys instead of Spider-Man toys, maintaining the same pattern: search for a toy category for kids and sort by price ascending. Uses existing evaluator functions to verify breadcrumbs and URL parameters on Kohl's website.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies ALL instruction requirements: search query (Disney princess, toys, kids) checked via breadcrumbs and URL parameters, sorting (cheapest to most expensive) verified via selector text 'Price Low-High' and URL parameter 'S=4'
Multi-layered verification approach: checks both HTML elements (breadcrumbs class 'pmpSearch_breadcrumb', selector class 'sbSelector') AND URL parameters for robustness
Properly handles case-insensitive matching: getter converts keys to lowercase, expected values are lowercase, metric comparison will work correctly
Checks for unexpected extra elements via 'is_other_exist' field to ensure only expected search/filter criteria are applied
Getter logic (get_active_tab_html_parse with category 'class&url') can correctly extract the needed state from Kohl's website HTML structure
Metric logic (check_direct_json_object) performs correct key-by-key comparison between extracted result and expected values
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding postconfig to ensure page has fully loaded and settled after search/sort actions, as web navigation may take time or involve redirects

Evaluator is tightly coupled to Kohl's website HTML structure (specific class names 'pmpSearch_breadcrumb', 'sbSelector', URL parameter 'S=4'). If Kohl's changes their website structure, the evaluator would need updates. This is acceptable for domain-specific tasks but worth noting.
Could add timeout/retry logic in getter if page elements are not immediately available after navigation
